question: Should AG-UI be a packaged bundled channel, or an externally installed official plugin using a supported external-channel distribution path?
rationale: The PR currently combines bundled activation and documentation with an explicit packaged-dist exclusion and ClawHub/npm release metadata; resolving that is a product and ownership choice, not a safe mechanical repair.

options.title: Adopt as bundled
options.body: Remove the packaged-dist exclusion, retain the bundled entry and generated metadata, and have security approve the exact dependency graph.

options.title: Externalize deliberately
options.body: Move the feature to a supported installable plugin path and update setup, discovery, runtime resolution, and documentation so it no longer claims to ship inside OpenClaw.

options.title: Pause pending a generic seam
options.body: Keep the work open but do not merge until maintainers decide whether the core needs a general external-channel capability first.

recommendation.title: Adopt as bundled
recommendation.body: Remove the packaged-dist exclusion, retain the bundled entry and generated metadata, and have security approve the exact dependency graph.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available technical owner for the imported feature and have documented the channel-boundary rationale in the PR discussion.
